tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Live scan of one website's AI search visibility (GEO/AEO, SEO for AI assistants): can ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity crawl, read and cite it? Fetches the domain's /robots.txt, /llms.txt, /sitemap.xml and homepage, then returns a 0-100 score, grade, per-crawler allow/block status and prioritized fixe

tools.name: crawler_policy_guide
tools.description: Static reference of 13 known AI crawlers and control tokens (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended...): owner, purpose, whether each drives AI citations or training, plus rules of thumb. Use to decide which bots to allow or block. No site is fetched. Do NOT use to audit a

tools.name: robots_txt_for_ai
tools.description: Generate robots.txt User-agent rules for all known AI crawlers from a chosen policy (max_visibility, search_only, block_training, block_all_ai), with optional Content-Signal and Sitemap lines, to paste into an existing robots.txt. tools.name: llms_txt_draft

tools.name: schema_jsonld_sample
tools.description: Generate a schema.org JSON-LD snippet (Organization, LocalBusiness, Product with Offer, or FAQPage) from your details, with placement tips, so search engines and AI assistants can identify the entity.
